head: 2a62cbb7447c2c52e6b2be4029803f6ee64002d9
title: Fixed settings edits being lost during a pending save
body:
Fixes https://github.com/TryGhost/Ghost/issues/32421

Saving settings A and typing B before the request completes can replace B with A and close the editor. Track the form version associated with each save, reject overlapping saves, and refresh settings from context only when editing has ended. New edits remain `unsaved`, preserving existing discard warnings; a stale completion returns `false` so callers keep the editor open.

Validation:
- 28 focused hook/context tests passed with Node 22.23.4/Vitest 4.1.12 in an isolated sandbox (one worker), after the expected failing regressions. Cases cover newer edits, context refresh, overlapping saves, reset, rejection and retry.
- The context test uses real hooks with mocked API/error dependencies; it is not browser E2E.
- Commit hooks passed formatting, both package ESLint checks, dependency boundaries and staged-file scanning. Shade declarations were generated using the official TypeScript, alias-rewrite and declaration-check commands so type-aware lint resolved the real dependency.
- Full `pnpm check` was not completed for this branch. The batch's check on the same source/dependency base stopped at repository-wide formatting before full lint/tests.

[Reproduction and validation details](https://github.com/JoaoMarcos44/Ghost/blob/e2433b625dc9f4776ecbf3dec55e7ca4c2f7849f/reports/ghost-prs-2026-10-31/settings/results.md) · [Visual explanation](https://github.com/JoaoMarcos44/Ghost/blob/e2433b625dc9f4776ecbf3dec55e7ca4c2f7849f/reports/ghost-prs-2026-10-31/settings/infographic_report.md)

`131-134`: ** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Keep the navigation modal open when `handleSave` returns `false`.** If the form changes while the save is pending, `handleSave()` returns `false` and keeps the form unsaved. ```diff if (navigation.validate() && secondaryNavigation.validate()) { - await handleSave(); - updateRoute('navigation'); + if (await handleSave()) { + updateRoute('navigation'); + } } ```
